instagram.research: What Meta said on {read}: an app used only for a business you own or manage needs no App Review at Standard Access. Instagram publishes only to professional accounts. The file goes from your computer to Meta with the resumable upload, so no public address of your video is needed, and none is created. A Reel is 3 seconds to 15 minutes, up to 300 MB, with a caption of up to 2,200 characters and 30 hashtags; a cover image is not offered, because Meta takes it only from a public address. A Reel has no private mode, so every post goes out as public. An app may publish 100 posts in a moving 24 hours.

The file goes from your computer to Meta with the resumable upload, so no public address of your video is needed, and none is created. A Page Reel is 3 to 90 seconds, 9:16, at least 540 by 960, 24 to 60 frames a second; an app may publish 30 in a moving 24 hours. Meta states no largest file and no longest description, so Stuarty applies 1 GiB and 2,200 characters. Only Reels are offered: a longer or wider video is refused with the limit it breaks. There is no cover image field and no private mode, so every post goes out as public.

x.research: What X said on {read}: a post is paid per request, $0.015, or $0.200 for a post with a URL, and the prices change, so you can correct them here when they do. A post may hold up to 280 weighted characters (a link counts 23) and one video of up to 20 minutes and 8 GB. The video goes up from your computer in chunks, so no public address of it is needed. If an answer is lost after a post was sent, Stuarty does not send it again by itself, because a post costs money each time: look at your timeline first. Not verified without your app: whether X changes the refresh token at each use, and whether a localhost callback is accepted.

tiktok.research: What TikTok said on {read}: the upload to the inbox leaves a draft for you to review and publish in the TikTok app; it takes the file and nothing else, so the title, the text and the tags you write here are not sent and there is no AI label to set (set it in TikTok). An app that has not been audited cannot post publicly and the audit is meant for a product for a wide public, not for a tool that posts to your own accounts, so Stuarty offers no public post and no way around that. The file goes up from your computer in chunks, so no public address of it is needed. TikTok keeps at most 5 drafts waiting in 24 hours through the API. Not verified without your app: whether TikTok approves the scope video.upload for an app of your own.
